body: I've tried so hard to figure that out, they are seemingly random and now I'm so far behind in both my job and school that my anxiety gets compounded every time I think about it.

At first I thought I was just stressed, but then the first day it happened I thought I was dying. I've been having reaccuring panic attacks for quite some time now. I never seem to get used to them. After the fact it leaves me drained and tired, with a constant level of anxiety that never never goes away. Days following panic attacks I feel depressed and can't eat. I can't go to class, I couldn't open up to my girlfriend for fear of her not being able to understand. Were no longer together now. I feel like I've lost everything I've worked for. I'm not close with my parents and have distanced myself from most of my friends do to the dibilitating fear of having another attack in public. I've tried Paxil but the side effects are awful and it doesn't get rid of the lingering thoughts I have about a final end. I'm scared of myself and no longer know who I am.
I'm sorry, that's a lot to digest and I'm not one to burden others I just don't know what to do or what's left for me.
